_: Voice narration on GitHub with Gemini TTS (.github/workflows/narration-tts.yml). Edit, commit, push: the workflow voices what is listed and commits the takes to audio/vo-takes/. `scripts`: synth-vo.py scripts to voice in `voice`. Bump `run` to re-run with no other change. Voice each line once (the daily quota is shared).

takes.name: list-b
takes.text: understands it, sums it up, files it by topic,
takes.style: Brisk and pleased, rattling off the list with a smile; light, no drawn-out words, the sentence carries on. Pace: Brisk, playful and conversational, about 175 words a minute; pauses short and light, never a dramatic beat. The product name "Machina" is the Latin word, said the classical Latin way: MAH-kee-nah, stress on the FIRST syllable; "ch" is a hard "k"; open vowels, "a" as in "father" (not as in "cat"), a short "ee", and a clear "ah" at the end, not "nuh". Never mah-KEE-nah.
